value.name: engine.Unknown
value.doc: holds components whose type is not registered in this build

value.name: engine.Tags
value.doc: Tags names groups this node belongs to; scripts find them with scene.WithTag.

value.name: engine.SpriteRenderer
value.doc: Draws a texture region at the node transform.

value.name: engine.Camera2D
value.doc: Renders an orthographic view from the node transform.

value.name: engine.Camera3D
value.doc: Renders a perspective view looking down the node -Z axis.

value.name: engine.MeshRenderer
value.doc: Draws an unlit mesh at the node transform.

value.name: engine.Script
value.doc: holds the Aego Script attachments of a node

value.name: physics.Body2D
value.doc: Simulates the node as a rigid body. Colliders on the node and its children form its shape.

value.name: physics.BoxCollider2D
value.doc: Box shape in node space.

value.name: physics.CircleCollider2D
value.doc: Circle shape. Needs a uniform node scale.

value.name: physics.CapsuleCollider2D
value.doc: Capsule along the local X axis; Length is the full extent including the caps.

value.name: physics.PolygonCollider2D
value.doc: Convex polygon of 3 to 8 points.

value.name: physics.EdgeCollider2D
value.doc: Polyline for level geometry. OneSided lets bodies pass from below.

value.name: physics.DistanceJoint2D
value.doc: Keeps a distance between this body and the Target body. Length 0 uses the distance at start.

value.name: physics.RevoluteJoint2D
value.doc: Pins this body to the Target body at Anchor, with an optional limit and motor.

value.name: camera.VirtualCamera2D
value.doc: A camera pose the brain can pick. The highest priority wins; switching blends from the current view.

value.name: camera.CameraFollow2D
value.doc: Moves its virtual camera after Target, with a deadzone, damping and lookahead.

value.name: camera.CameraShake2D
value.doc: Tunes the shake of its virtual camera. Shake grows with trauma and fades over time.

value.name: camera.CameraZone2D
value.doc: While Target is inside Area, Camera gets Priority and the zone's zoom and bounds.

value.name: camera.CameraBrain2D
value.doc: Picks which output of virtual cameras drives this Camera 2D. Without it the camera shows the main output.

value.name: save.Persist
value.doc: Persist saves the node's transform and enabled flag in save games.
